purpose: Research recommendations for reducing Memglide cost regressions without weakening current source correctness or trust boundaries.

historical_context.scope: Ten paired bare-Codex/compact-Memglide tasks, eight source-prepared and two identical caller-context controls. Research does not rewrite or combine prior results.

claims.claim: GPT-5.6+ implicit cache lookup includes eligible message endings, not arbitrary common substrings inside an extended/changed message. Keeping a source text prefix in one changing task message alone does not establish a reusable source cache boundary.
GPT-5.6+ cache routing is automatic; optional prompt_cache_key provides separate accounting. This API guidance does not disclose actual ChatGPT-authenticated Codex routing.

Installed Codex0.159.2 exec root/resume input construction accepts one prompt string and creates one UserInput::Text, with optional images. No structured arbitrary input-message or explicit breakpoint CLI surface was found in the inspected definitions/request schema.

Maintaining a conversation/session does not guarantee cache hits; previous input remains billable in chained API responses. Native resume should preserve actual prior message boundaries, but cost needs full-sequence measurement.

Native compaction can replace history and truncate/discard older user content. Native exec JSONL has no dedicated compaction item/event and maps unsupported item types to None; a thread/hash receipt alone cannot establish that earlier full source remains visible.

Native exec usage_from_last_total copies ThreadTokenUsage.total fields. Protocol TokenUsageInfo appends last usage into cumulative totals and includes reset/fill behavior. Multi-turn cost evaluators must verify cumulative accounting and avoid summing resumed cumulative totals blindly. Exact resume persistence/reset semantics were not fully traced.

Use high-signal bounded context, lightweight identifiers and just-in-time/hybrid retrieval; consolidate frequently chained operations and measure tool errors, calls, tokens, runtime and held-out outcomes. Guidance is not proof of Memglide-specific gains.

An explicit bounded validation recipe or approved validation/config sources may remove redundant test-discovery work after source reads are already avoided. It must be measured as an optional product feature, with an equal-recipe control for attribution; no repository-derived command is automatically executed.

recommended_architecture.decision: Preserve exact bypass, no auxiliary model/MCP call, current full-source secure reads, source/policy/approval rechecks and canonical compact format.
recommended_architecture.proof_required: Unit/security/freshness/complete-source and exact task-byte checks; full regression/integration suites.

recommended_architecture.decision: Offer a bounded, explicit caller-provided validation recipe and/or explicitly focused complete validation/config sources. Treat repository data as untrusted, do not import/evaluate/expand or execute it during preparation.
recommended_architecture.proof_required: Boundary/size/type/path/injection tests; first inspect traces for a real discovery cost; fresh matched native benchmark plus optional equal-recipe ablation.

recommended_architecture.decision: Document supported explicit same-thread resume for related tasks. Keep omission caller-controlled unless actual retained source and compaction state can be verified through a supported native interface.
recommended_architecture.proof_required: Matched independent task histories, complete current-source rechecks, final cumulative usage/delta validation, complete sequence cost and success, compaction/stale-source probes.

recommended_architecture.decision: Use only explicit local hints for automatic source selection; do not tune a universal byte threshold or semantic classifier on the eight observed retrieval cases. Preserve native discovery when evidence is insufficient.
recommended_architecture.proof_required: Fresh relevant/missing-context corpus, false-skip and retrieval-completeness grading, cheap decision-path CPU/wall measurements.

recommended_architecture.decision: Keep a few consolidated bounded source/retrieval operations for larger ambiguous tasks; return complete relevant bodies plus explicit omissions, with current source validation. Avoid eager whole-project preload.
recommended_architecture.proof_required: Larger unfamiliar held-out repositories, dependency coverage and freshness probes, native MCP invocation verification where MCP is the treatment, lifecycle resource and cost accounting.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: Spoofed cache keys/session IDs or unsupported breakpoint flags
rejected_or_deferred.reason: The native CLI does not expose the required controls in the inspected surface; identity spoofing is not a validated optimization and invalidates fair comparisons.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: Automatic omit-unchanged source based only on a thread ID and hash receipt
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Same source bytes do not prove presence after native compaction/truncation; receipt-only omission can compromise completeness.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: Move untrusted source into trusted developer/system instructions
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Changes instruction authority to manufacture caching boundaries and weakens source trust boundaries.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: LLM classifier/embedding/summarization pass on every ordinary task
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Adds model/services and local overhead; no measured benefit pays for it on current small-task workload.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: Arbitrary token padding, default prewarming or speculative duplicate model calls
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Adds billed work/cache writes and can distort experiments; all lifecycle costs would need separate evidence.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: Switch benchmark to smaller model, lower reasoning, Flex or Batch to claim a retrieval improvement
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Changes quality/latency/tariff settings and no longer isolates the architecture under matched settings.

rejected_or_deferred.mechanism: Skip source, ignore-policy or approval checks; use mtime-only caching
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Can expose excluded/stale source and compromise existing security and freshness results.

limitations: This is an engineering literature/source review, not a proof of a universal best architecture.
No original scientific papers or competitor full implementations were newly reviewed; primary engineering guides and selected native functions were reviewed with explicit scope.
Native API schema support does not establish the server behavior or tariff of ChatGPT-authenticated Codex.
The exact actual server prefix, cache boundary hit, per-inference count and billed charge remain unobserved.
No held-out task gold patches or graders were inspected or used to choose architecture during this research.
Failed URLs and unread downloaded artifacts remain in the ledger.
